title: Courtyard replanting for a Fernwood strata

seo.title: Sample project: Fernwood strata courtyard | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: a shaded strata courtyard in Fernwood, Victoria, replanted with shade-tolerant natives in two phases so residents kept access.

summary: A shaded courtyard with failing shrubs replanted with shade-tolerant natives.
challenge: Half the shrubs in a shaded courtyard had died, and owners disagreed about what to plant instead.
approach: We gave council two planting options, each with its own plant list, so the decision could be made at a meeting.
The work was done in two halves, so residents always had a clear path to their doors, and the new beds were edged and mulched.
result: Council chose a plan from written options, and residents kept access throughout.
